name: marketing-ctas
title: CTAs
description: Full-section call-to-action blocks for marketing landing pages, combining headline copy, supporting text, CTA buttons, and imagery in side-by-side, centered newsletter, and image-grid layout patterns.
useWhen: Closing a marketing page section with a conversion-oriented message and primary CTA button.
Presenting a newsletter signup inline within a landing page between feature sections.
Combining a text pitch with product imagery in a two-column layout to drive trial signups.
avoidWhen: The CTA is a single button inline with body text — use a button component instead.
Multiple competing CTAs are needed in the same section — users should focus on one action.
The action requires significant user input beyond an email — use a contact form instead.
responsiveBehavior: Two-column CTA layouts stack to a single column on mobile with the image below the copy. Newsletter signup CTAs compress to a stacked input+button layout on small screens.
accessibility: CTA buttons must have descriptive labels — 'Get started' is acceptable only if context makes the action clear.
Form fields in newsletter CTA variants must have visible or programmatic labels.
Decorative background images or shapes must use aria-hidden='true' or empty alt text.

variants.title: Base with content and call to action on the left, image on the right
variants.description: Two-column CTA block with headline, description, and buttons on the left and a product screenshot or illustration on the right.
accessibility: Right-side image must have descriptive alt text; CTA buttons have specific action labels.

variants.title: Base with content and call to action on the left, image on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Two-column image-and-copy CTA block adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Headline, body text, and CTA button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark section backgrounds.

variants.title: Newsletter sign up form with centered content and form
variants.description: Centered newsletter CTA section with a headline, subtext, and an inline email input plus subscribe button — for mid-page lead capture.
accessibility: Email input must have a visible or programmatic label; submit button label clearly describes the action.

variants.title: Newsletter sign up form with centered content and form (Dark)
variants.description: Centered newsletter signup CTA adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Email input and subscribe button must meet contrast requirements on dark CTA section backgrounds.

variants.title: Base with content can call to action on the left, offset image on the right
variants.description: Two-column CTA with a vertically offset or oversized image on the right that bleeds outside the section boundary — a design-forward layout for product launches.
accessibility: Offset image must have descriptive alt text; ensure the overflow image does not hide page content on smaller screens.

variants.title: Base with content can call to action on the left, offset image on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Offset-image two-column CTA adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Text and button contrast must be maintained on dark CTA section backgrounds.

variants.title: Content and call to action in block color on the left, grid of images on the right
variants.description: Block-color CTA panel on the left paired with a grid of product or lifestyle images on the right — for brand-heavy sections on eCommerce and lifestyle marketing pages.
accessibility: Each image in the grid must have descriptive alt text; CTA button on block-color background must meet contrast requirements.

variants.title: Content and call to action in block color on the left, grid of images on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Block-color panel plus image grid CTA adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Block color panel text and CTA must meet contrast on both the block color and the surrounding dark page background.
